source_text: Rabbinic interpretations emphasize brit milah's role beyond mere covenantal sign: Maimonides (Rambam) in his Mishneh Torah (Hilchot Milah) and commentary views it as surgically diminishing excessive sexual impulse, thereby aiding adherence to Torah prohibitions against illicit relations and fostering self-control. [32]
